# Essential Pest Control

Essential Pest Control provides residential and commercial pest management in Gauteng, South Africa. Pretoria, Pretoria East and Centurion are the primary residential service region. Booked services are also provided in Sandton, Randburg, Kempton Park and other Gauteng areas.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://essentialpestcontrol.co.za/
- Commercial pest control: https://essentialpestcontrol.co.za/commercial
- Pest control advice: https://essentialpestcontrol.co.za/blog
